back: A high-frequency wave of constant amplitude and frequency that is modulated to carry a signal.
The carrier's amplitude varies in step with the signal's displacement; its frequency stays constant.
The carrier's frequency varies in step with the signal's displacement; its amplitude stays constant.
Size of the frequency deviation ∝ signal amplitude (loudness); rate of deviation = signal frequency (pitch).
Short aerials (λ comparable to aerial), each station its own frequency for tuning, suitable propagation.
AM: narrow bandwidth, more stations, long range, cheap, noisy. FM: wide bandwidth, better quality, less noise, VHF line of sight.
LW 30-300 kHz; MW 300 kHz-3 MHz (AM); VHF 30-300 MHz (FM 87.5-108 MHz); UHF 300 MHz-3 GHz (TV, phones).
MW AM: 9 kHz channels (audio to 4.5 kHz). FM: about 200 kHz per station (75 kHz deviation, audio to 15 kHz).
